FINANCIAL ADVISORY RULES

Income & Savings:
- Minimum recommended savings: 20% of monthly income
- Ideal savings target: 30% of income
- Emergency fund should cover 3–6 months of expenses

Debt & EMI:
- EMI should not exceed 30% of monthly income
- Maximum Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio: 60%
- DTI above 70% is considered high risk

Loan Guidelines:
- Loan eligibility depends on stable income
- Maximum loan suggested: 15–20x monthly income
- Avoid loans if savings are below 10%

Risk Indicators:
- High EMI + low savings → risky profile
- High income + low debt → strong profile
- Irregular income → moderate risk

General:
- Financial discipline improves approval chances
- Diversified savings preferred over single source
